label: Every object of thought is affirmed or denied…, from Every proposition is the object of some act…
meaning: Bridge (#401): the formalization's unattributed extension of the thought argument's first half to every proposition (STMT-THOUGHT-AFFIRMS-OR-DENIES-EVERY-PROPOSITION) entails the sourced first half, *Metaphysics* IV.7, 1012a2-3 (STMT-OBJECT-OF-THOUGHT-AFFIRMED-OR-DENIED): whatever is the object of some thought is the object of a thought that affirms or denies it. Instantiate the extension at that object. The extension is strictly about more propositions; this shows it is no weaker than the sourced sentence.
